messages:
jamie: Heads up — putting together a small healthboard for the continuous batcher telemetry. Want to capture batch_utilization, avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, and kv_cache_hit. Thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sasha: +1. Also include `queue_wait_p50/p95` and `tail_latency_p99` for token infra regressions. We keep missing tail spikes.

liam: Agree. We should show kernel selection mix (fp16-int8-p4x) as a stacked area — helps correlate perf drops when scheduler picks slower kernel.

maria: Can we add a per-model token_budget_target and an incident flag when budget is exceeded? Example: `token_budget_target=20000` for interactive models.

jamie: Yep. Plan: panels -> 1) Batch utilization (%) 2) Avg queue depth (requests) 3) Tokens/sec (global + per-model) 4) KV cache hit rate (%) 5) Kernel selection ratio 6) Tail latencies. Also a small table for current token_budget_target overrides.

sasha: For alerts: alert when batch_utilization < 30% for 15m AND avg_tokens_per_batch < configured minimum. Also when perf regressions correlate w/ kernel switch.

liam: Quick PromQL sketches (feel free to copy):
```promql
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (cluster)
100 * sum(batch_token_utilized_total) / sum(batch_token_capacity_total)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

maria: For KV cache, add a panel: `kv_cache_hit_ratio = hits / (hits + misses)` and expose prefix-eviction rate. We saw a regression when eviction rate jumped.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: grafana/dashboard/continuous-batcher v1.2 -> staging by @jamie at 2026-02-10T11:22:15Z

jamie: Experiment note — changed queue_policy from FIFO to age-aware fairness for low-latency customers in canary. Observed 12% drop in p99 latency but batch_utilization dipped ~8%. Need to track head-of-line blocking metric.

liam: Suggest a new metric: `head_of_line_block_time_seconds` measuring time a request waited behind preempting long requests. Helps explain utilization vs latency tradeoff.

sasha: UX ask: add a small interactive toggle to plot per-model token budget vs observed tokens/sec so product can tune budgets.

maria: Linking the PR with the KV cache tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2345 — this caused a short spike in eviction_rate last week.

ops-monitor-bot: anomaly detected: batch_utilization < 20% on cluster-us-west-2 for 00:07:32. Related ticket created: INF-4821

jamie: Thanks — I'll wire up the alerts and build the panels in draft. Will run A/B: baseline vs age-aware queue_policy for 48h and post results here with snapshot links.

sasha: Please include a lightweight table for rollout filters: `model_tags`, `min_tokens_for_batching`, `token_budget_target`, `queue_timeout_ms`. That helped during the last fallback.

liam: One more: add a tiny panel showing kernel-selection latency delta (avg latency when kernel=A minus kernel=B) so we can catch bad heuristics quickly.

maria: If anyone wants to help with Grafana queries ping me. I'll create the dashboard and mock panels in staging.

jamie: Perfect. I'll open a tracking thread and attach the dashboard link when ready: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/xyz/continuous-batcher-healthboard

sasha: :eyes: excited to see the head-of-line metric.

jamie: Closing loop — timeline: build + alerting in 2d, run canary 48h, review metrics and decide token_budget tuning. Will paste final graphs here.
